sourceEvidence: packages/contracts/src/provider/index.ts is the strict runtime contract for exact Provider types, draft steps, requirement snapshots, review states, and explicit response DTOs.
apps/api/src/modules/provider/router.ts defines the seven implemented routes; apps/api/src/modules/provider/auth.ts derives ownership from the signed Provider subject.
apps/api/src/modules/provider/repository.ts creates identity/profile/application records and submits them through transactions with optimistic version checks.
apps/api/src/modules/provider/requirements.ts keeps requirements in a version registry and evaluates the conditional authorization letter through a machine-readable predicate.

apps/api/tests/provider/ covers strict contracts, schemas/indexes, provider-type requirements, invalid transitions, replayed authority, role enforcement, ownership, incomplete submissions, and immutable snapshots.
apps/api/openapi/openapi.json, apps/api/postman/Sadat-Real-Estate.postman_collection.json, API_ENDPOINT_BLUEPRINT.json, and executable inventory are synchronized at 19 active routes.
